units.source_text: 先生和我穿过墓地，向马路走去。

en.t: Sensei and I passed through the cemetery and walked toward the road.

units.source_text: 在标有依萨贝拉某某之墓、神仆洛金之墓的墓碑旁边，立着一座写着“一切众生悉有佛性”的塔婆 ,,还有的墓碑上写着全权公使某某。

en.t: Beside gravestones marked as the grave of Isabella so-and-so and the grave of Loghin, servant of God, stood a stupa inscribed, "All living beings have Buddha-nature"; another gravestone bore the name of so-and-so, minister plenipotentiary.

units.source_text: 我在一个刻着“安德烈”三个字的小墓碑前问先生：“这个名字用外文该怎么念？”

en.t: In front of a small gravestone carved with the three characters "安德烈," I asked Sensei, "How would this name be read in a foreign language?"

units.source_text: “我想，应该念作Andore吧。”先生苦笑了一下说。

en.t: "I suppose it would be read Andore," Sensei said with a wry smile.

units.source_text: 对于式样各异的墓碑，先生似乎并没有像我那样觉得滑稽，有讽刺味。

en.t: As for the gravestones in their various styles, Sensei did not seem to find them as comical or ironic as I did.

units.source_text: 我指着圆形的墓石或细长的花岗岩墓碑，不停地说这说那。

en.t: I pointed at round tombstones and slender granite grave markers, going on and on about this and that.

units.source_text: 起初，先生还默默地听着，最后对我说：“看来，你还没有认真考虑过死的问题吧？”

en.t: At first Sensei listened in silence, but at last he said to me, "It seems you have not yet seriously thought about death, have you?"

units.source_text: 我沉默了，先生也没有再说什么。

en.t: I fell silent, and Sensei said nothing more.

units.source_text: 墓地边缘挺立着一棵参天的大银杏树。

en.t: At the edge of the cemetery stood a great ginkgo tree towering into the sky.

units.source_text: 走到银杏树下时，先生抬头望着高高的树梢说：“再过几天，就好看了。

en.t: When we reached the ginkgo tree, Sensei looked up at its high branches and said, "In a few more days, it will be beautiful.

units.source_text: 树叶都变黄了，这片地上会覆盖一层金色的落叶。”

en.t: The leaves will all turn yellow, and this ground will be covered with a layer of golden fallen leaves."

units.source_text: 原来先生每个月都要从这棵树下经过一次。

en.t: It turned out that Sensei passed beneath this tree once every month.

units.source_text: 前面有个人正在修整凹凸不平的土地，建造新墓地，他停下手里的铁锹，望着我们。

en.t: Ahead of us, a man who was leveling the uneven ground to make a new grave plot stopped his shovel and looked at us.

units.source_text: 我们由此向左一拐，走上了马路。

en.t: From there we turned left and came out onto the road.

units.source_text: 我没有特别要去的地方，只是跟着先生走。

en.t: I had nowhere in particular to go, so I simply followed Sensei.

units.source_text: 先生的话比平时更少了，不过我并没因此感到局促，只是跟着先生信步往前走。

en.t: Sensei spoke even less than usual, but I did not feel awkward because of it; I simply strolled along after him.
